Container.Name: kw-proxy
Container.Overview: Outbound gateway for the KW edge (kw-proxy): a stock Squid that allows each registered KW container to reach only its own destination names, and refuses private and internal addresses on the resolved IP. NO PORT IS PUBLISHED: it listens on 3128 (allowlisted) and 3129 (userlinks) on the internal network only, and containers reach it as kw-proxy:3128. NETWORK: Network stays bridge in this template, because a template cannot create a network; set Network to the internal Docker network the operator created by hand before the first start. Its second leg is per host, re-attached by System Admin's host watcher (network.md rule 7), not by this template: br0 on one host, a bond0 macvlan with a registered LAN address on the other. No other KW container has a second network. CONFIG: squid.conf, the destinations/ allowlists and the two operator include files are mounted read-only from the host. The operator files (operator-sources.conf and operator-destinations.conf) are host-held and are not in kw-edge: a missing one stops the proxy from starting, and an empty operator-sources.conf denies every request. LOG: the destination log is a host directory mounted at /var/log/squid; rotation is the host's logrotate, set by System Admin. RESOURCE LIMITS: CPU and memory are System Admin's per-instance values, recorded in this Overview. IMAGE: ubuntu/squid:6.13-25.04_edge pinned by digest, the same pin as kw-edge's pins.json.
Container.Description: Outbound gateway for the KW edge: lets each registered container reach only its own destination names, and refuses private addresses. Publishes no port; reachable on the internal network as kw-proxy:3128.

Config.Name: squid.conf
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Host path of kw-edge's config/squid/squid.conf, mounted read-only at /etc/squid/squid.conf. Set an absolute path on a POOL, e.g. /mnt/<pool>/appdata/kw-proxy/squid/squid.conf.

Config.Name: Destination allowlists
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Host directory holding kw-edge's config/squid/destinations/ (one allowlist per source, plus smtp.allow), mounted read-only, e.g. /mnt/<pool>/appdata/kw-proxy/squid/destinations. A missing directory still starts; that source then reaches nothing.

Config.Name: Operator sources include
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Host-held file of source ACL lines, one per registered container: acl src_<name> src <container-internal-address>. Mounted read-only. Its path, e.g. /mnt/<pool>/appdata/kw-proxy/operator-sources.conf, is set by the operator. A missing file stops the proxy from starting.

Config.Name: Operator destinations include
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Host-held file of operator-owned destination names, one per line: acl dst_<name> dstdomain <host-name>. Mounted read-only. Its path, e.g. /mnt/<pool>/appdata/kw-proxy/operator-destinations.conf, is set by the operator. A missing file stops the proxy from starting; an empty one adds nothing.

Config.Name: Destination log
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Host directory for the destination log (destination.log), writable by the proxy. Set an absolute path on a POOL, e.g. /mnt/<pool>/appdata/kw-proxy/logs. Rotated by the host's logrotate, set by System Admin.
